column1: # What each predicate of the retained-process classifier MEANS, one sentence per word.
# The probe learned to name its refusals (#699, #719, #741) and its receivers still reported all
# of them as "has owning or unknown processes" — a sentence that is true of exactly one of these
# predicates and reconstitutes, one layer up, the collapse those issues removed one layer down
# (#738). It lives in a data file because both receivers read it: `environment.sh`, which decides
# whether a retained replacement proceeds, and `verify-preview-environment.ts`, which reports the
# `<predicate><TAB><sentence>`; a `HOLD:` prefix and the predicate itself are added by the reader.
# A predicate with no row here is reported as unknown to the receiver rather than guessed at:
# adding a word to the classifier without adding it here is a diagnosable state, not a silent
# fallback to a sentence about processes.
